source_refs.note: 14.16.3 Political Issues: a main subheading of 14.16 Economic, social and political issues, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 319-319.

items: Effective air quality regulations laagu karna political aur economic interests (faide) ki wajah se mushkil ho sakta hai.

Air pollution borders (sarhadon) tak limited nahi rehti, is liye is ke management ke liye international cooperation (mulkon ka mil kar kaam karna) chahiye. (Kitab mein 'corporation' chhapa hai; matlab cooperation hai.)

Air quality regulations laagu karne ke liye strict governance (sakht hukoomat) chahiye, jo industrial growth aur economic development ko slow kar sakta hai aur political jhagron ki wajah ban sakta hai.
Air pollution se nimatne ke liye multi-faceted (har pehlu dekhne wala) approach chahiye jo socio-economic aur technological baaton mein balance (tawazun) rakhe.

blocks.title: Kitab ka lafz
blocks.text: Pehli line mein kitab 'social and potential issues' likhti hai; matlab 'social and political issues' hai, jaisa ke 14.16.3 ka heading batata hai.

blocks.prompt: Smog ke mausam mein bhattiyan band karne ke government plan se kaun se economic, social aur political issues uthenge?
blocks.explanation: Economic: bhatti owners (maalikan) aur mazdooron ki aamdani rukti hai aur eenton ki qeemat barhti hai, lekin hospital ke kharche, kaam ke zaya din aur faslon ka nuqsan bachta hai. Social: ghareeb mazdoor nuqsan uthate hain jabke ghareeb muhallon ko sehat ka sab se zyada faida hota hai. Political: owners pabandi ki mukhalifat karte hain, implementation (laagu karne) ke liye strong hukoomat chahiye, aur smog sarhadon ke paar jati hai is liye parosi ilaqon ke saath cooperation zaroori hai.

items: Economic: kam productivity, faslon ka nuqsan, infrastructure ki kharabi.
Social: bachche, buzurg aur ghareeb sab se zyada affected; quality of life kam; migration (jagah chhorna).
Political: interests ki rukawat; international cooperation zaroori; governance aur development mein balance.
